seo.title: Paul's | Neighborhood Bar in Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn
seo.description: Paul's is a friendly neighborhood bar on Nostrand Ave in Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn. Pull-tab happy hour Mon–Fri 3–8 PM, sports with sound, canned beer, cocktails, and 10-inch pizzas.

about.heading: Regulars and first-timers, same bar.
paragraphs: Paul's is a friendly local bar on Nostrand Ave where everyone's welcome. Come in on your own, and chances are you'll leave knowing a few more neighbors — that's kind of the point.

We screen sports with the sound on, host guest bartenders, charity nights, and games, and keep it simple behind the bar: canned beer only, good cocktails, wine, and non-alcoholic options. There are regular kitchen pop-ups, and you're always welcome to bring your own food.
